what_it_is: XDLINX Space Labs is a Hyderabad-based small-satellite company offering mission-as-a-service and satellite bus platforms, including the Elytra line demonstrated in orbit in 2023-2024. It positions itself as a 'ready-to-launch' sovereign bus supplier and mission integrator, with an advanced satellite integration facility opened in Hyderabad in 2026.
india_angle: XDLINX raised a reported $7M seed round, contracted additional electric-propulsion units from France's Exotrail for delivery through 2027, and is publicly reported to be under contract for a 15-satellite sovereign constellation - one of the larger private Indian bus orders to date. The 2026 integration lab inauguration, held with ISRO leadership present, underscores its position in India's private satellite industrial base.
intelligence_assessment: Propulsion contracting and the constellation order are concrete commercial signals, but the customer behind the 15-satellite contract and delivery schedule are not fully public. Track satellite deliveries against the two-year contract window as the key verification milestone.

faq.q: What does XDLINX Space Labs do?
faq.a: It builds small-satellite bus platforms (including Elytra) and offers mission-as-a-service integration from Hyderabad, India.

faq.q: What is XDLINX's known order pipeline?
faq.a: Public reporting cites a 15-satellite sovereign constellation contract and repeat electric-propulsion orders from Exotrail.

faq.q: When was its integration lab opened?
faq.a: An advanced satellite integration facility in Hyderabad was inaugurated in May 2026.
